style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: the camera orbits him every beat and reverses the orbit at 1.65, 3.95 and 5.45, the cliff face raking past a horn away; he never stops striding along the ledge; ONE sideways move per beat, never chained; new shot size each beat; his muzzle never under a third of frame, jaw visible; the suits plunge across frame and past the lens, never straight down the frame
character: a shaggy markhor with huge corkscrew horns and a long beard, striding along a narrow ledge, muzzle and jaw clear
second_characters: A SWARM of investors in grey suits crowding the ledge and tipping off it, ONE of them plunging a shoulder from the lens every beat, crossing frame and hitting the glass; all of them moving
props: A SWARM of grey paper contracts torn out of the falling suits and whipping across the lens; ONE briefcase in the last investor's fist
prop_continuity: contracts fly off with every suit from 0.00, the briefcase rides in that fist until 7.30
environment: a bright ledge packed wall to wall with shuffling suits, a jagged cliff face a horn away raking the lens, white fog and lit peaks below and behind
light_events: white noon over the peaks, glare off the fog sweeping him every beat, a hard rim on his horns

audio.delivery: a level male chest voice around 130 Hz, unhurried, biting off each word, even 4.85 syllables per second, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: ro-GA, za-KRU-che-ny, moz-GI, BYS-try, ROST, bol-shin-STVO, in-VES-to-rov, PROS-to, PA-da-yut, E-tu, PRO-past
audio.pacing: speech runs unbroken 0.00 to 7.30, first word at 0.00, no gap between beats; after 7.30 wind, scree and paper fill the track to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: his jaw opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: wind over the ledge, scree sliding, paper whipping, boots scraping, bodies swallowed by the fog

timeline.a: he drives along the ledge, his horn already filling the glass, ONE suit plunging across it a shoulder away
he sweeps his corkscrew horns across the lens, another suit dropping past behind them
he shoulders through the queue along the ledge, the camera orbiting to his flank, a suit crossing the glass
he swings his beard across frame as the orbit whips to his other side, the cliff raking the lens
he strides on and the crowd pours off the ledge across the lens, contracts whipping with them
he rides the orbit at the lens, the whole column tipping past the glass in a grey sheet
the last investor grabs his horn and he flings him across the lens into the fog, the briefcase after him
he strides over the crumbling ledge, scree sheeting across the lens, contracts boiling past
he drives his muzzle into the glass, horns filling the frame, one last suit crossing behind him

must_appear: at 0.00 his horn already fills the glass and a suit is already plunging across it; a suit crosses the lens in every beat; nothing touches him before 7.30; he flings the last investor across the lens at 7.30; every word spoken, the last by 7.30; jaw open on every syllable
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, night, dark scene, a static camera, a still background, a parked hero, a hero moving up or down the frame, a wide or distant hero, standing bystanders, slow motion, letters, digits, a word not in the lines, a closed jaw while speaking, anything touching him before 7.30, a third horn on him, multiple markhors, a foreign accent
